Biochemical tests are performed to analyze protein structures and their carbohydrate components. The medical team needs to differentiate between glycoproteins and proteoglycans to better understand the patient’s condition. Which of the following statements is correct?

options.label: B
options.text: Proteoglycans have long mucopolysaccharide chains and high carbohydrate content.

options.label: D
